rv.q: The artistry of Madama Butterfly lives on in this intriguing new interpretation of the beloved classic.
This production of Butterfly is so transcendent, it could be performed in a hut with a mud floor and it would still blow your socks fully and completely off.
In all, it's good to see the Washington National Opera finding its footing and experimenting with the art form.

cn.t: Critics largely rave over WNO's bold, reimagined *Madama Butterfly*, praising its transcendent vision and Puccini's soaring score, though unconventional staging (miked singers, no traditional sets) draws minor reservations.
